function.name: _company_expert_save
function.description: Create or partially update a team expert. Omit expert.id when creating; when updating, pass an existing expert.id and only the fields to change. Unspecified fields are preserved by the server. Returns the expert ID.

expert.description: Expert base configuration. Creation requires name/avatar. Updating requires id and only the fields that should change. companyId/createAccountId/updateAccountId/createTime/updateTime are set by the backend; do not pass them.

id.description: Expert ID. Omit when creating; pass an existing expert ID when updating.

key.description: Expert identifier. Recommended when creating; include during update only when the user explicitly asks to change it.

name.description: Expert name, required, up to 128 characters.

description.description: Expert responsibility description. This will ultimately become the prompt used by the AI expert, so write it as a clear, complete, and executable expert prompt covering the expert role, scope of responsibility, working style, boundaries, and output requirements.

defaultInitPrompt.description: Default welcome message, up to 1024 characters. This is the first message proactively sent by the AI expert when the user opens the conversation; it is not a question prefilled in the user's input box.

knowledgeBaseList.description: IDs of team knowledge-base folders the expert may use. IDs must come from _company_knowledgebase_list. During update, omit this field to preserve bindings. An empty array clears bindings the current account is allowed to manage; hidden existing bindings are preserved by the server.

avatar.description: Avatar, required. Use an avatar URL or an Element UI icon class. Common icons: el-icon-user-solid, el-icon-user, el-icon-s-custom, el-icon-s-management, el-icon-s-data, el-icon-data-analysis, el-icon-s-opportunity, el-icon-s-marketing, el-icon-s-cooperation, el-icon-s-tools, el-icon-setting, el-icon-chat-dot-round, el-icon-message, el-icon-document, el-icon-folder, el-icon-search, el-icon-edit, el-icon-view, el-icon-star-on, el-icon-warning, el-icon-question, el-icon-info, el-icon-success. More icons: https://element.eleme.cn/#/en-US/component/icon.

status.description: Expert status. Use draft by default; use enabled only when the user explicitly asks to enable it.

aiModelKey.description: AI model key. You may call _company_get_ai_model_list first. Optional.

agentSettingJson.description: Agent setting JSON string, optional. Do not fill it unless explicitly needed.

skillList.description: Skills bound to the expert. During update, omit this field to preserve current bindings; an empty array clears all bindings. When changing Skills, start from the complete list returned by _company_expert_get and preserve metadata such as id, appDefineId, enable, and configJson for unchanged bindings. Do not fabricate skillId or skillKey.

id.description: Expert-Skill binding ID. Reuse the queried value for retained bindings; omit it for new bindings.

skillId.description: Skill ID, required. Must come from a real existing Skill; do not fabricate it.

appDefineId.description: App definition ID. Reuse the queried value for retained app-scoped bindings.

enable.description: Whether the Skill binding is enabled. Reuse the queried value for retained bindings.

configJson.description: Skill binding configuration JSON. Reuse the queried value for retained bindings.
